name: SplattingAvatar
definition: A real-time human avatar rendering method that embeds 3D Gaussians onto a driving mesh (FLAME) to enable non-ambiguous motion control and high-fidelity rendering of complex geometries like eyes and hair, avoiding the noise associated with nearest-triangle sampling in canonical space.
summary: SplattingAvatar is a real-time human avatar method that embeds 3D Gaussians onto a mesh in tangent space, using trainable embeddings for motion control to avoid noise and ensure strict mesh adherence.
